description: Create, update or delete (release) EC2 dedicated host.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: asset_ids
parameters.description: The IDs of the Outpost hardware assets on which to allocate the Dedicated Hosts. Targeting specific hardware assets on an Outpost can help to minimize latency between your workloads. This parameter is supported only if you specify outpost_arn. If you specify this parameter, you can omit quantity. If you specify both asset_ids and quantity, then the value for quantity must be equal to the number of asset_ids specified.

parameters.name: auto_placement
parameters.description: Indicates whether the host accepts any untargeted instance launches that match its instance type configuration, or if it only accepts Host tenancy instance launches that specify its unique host ID. Choices: "on" "off" ← (default)

parameters.name: availability_zone
parameters.description: The Availability Zone in which to allocate the Dedicated Host. Required if state=present.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: client_token
parameters.description: case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: host_id
parameters.description: The IDs of the Dedicated Hosts to release or modify

parameters.name: host_maintenance
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable host maintenance for the Dedicated Host. Choices: "on" "off" ← (default)

parameters.name: host_recovery
parameters.description: Indicates whether to enable or disable host recovery for the Dedicated Host. Host recovery is disabled by default. Choices: "on" "off" ← (default)

parameters.name: instance_family
parameters.description: Specifies the instance family to be supported by the Dedicated Hosts. If you specify an instance family, the Dedicated Hosts support multiple instance types within that instance family. At least one of instance_family or instance_type must be specified when allocating dedicated host. Mutually exclusive with paramter instance_type.

parameters.name: instance_type
parameters.description: Specifies the instance type to be supported by the Dedicated Hosts. If you specify an instance type, the Dedicated Hosts support instances of the specified instance type only. At least one of instance_family or instance_type must be specified when allocating dedicated host. Mutually exclusive with paramter instance_family.

parameters.name: lookup
parameters.description: Look up EC2 dedicated host by either tags or by host_id. If lookup=tag and tags is not specified then no lookup for an existing dedicated host is performed and a new dedicated host will be created. When using lookup=tag, multiple matches being found will result in a failure and no changes will be made. To change the tags of a dedicated host, use lookup=host_id. Choices: "tag" ← (default) "host_id"

parameters.name: outpost_arn
parameters.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Web Services Outpost on which to allocate the Dedicated Host.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: If purge_tags=true and tags is set, existing tags will be purged from the resource to match exactly what is defined by tags parameter. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified, even if purge_tags=True. Tag keys beginning with aws: are reserved by Amazon and can not be modified. As such they will be ignored for the purposes of the purge_tags parameter. See the Amazon documentation for more information https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws_tagging.html#tag-conventions. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: The number of Dedicated Hosts to allocate to your account with these parameters. Required when state=present. If you are allocating the Dedicated Hosts on an Outpost, and you specify asset_ids, you can omit this parameter. If you specify both asset_ids and quantity, then the value that you specify for quantity must be equal to the number of asset_ids specified.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete dedicated host. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary representing the tags to be applied to the resource. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

# Release dedicated hosts
- name: Release dedicated host
  amazon.aws.ec2_dedicated_host:
    host_id: "h-0123456789abcdef0"

# Allocate dedicated host using instance type
- name: Allocate dedicated host using instance_type
  amazon.aws.ec2_dedicated_host:
    availability_zone: us-east-1a
    quantity: 1
    instance_type: mac2.metal
    tags:
      Scope: Mac

return_values.name: host
return_values.description: Information about the dedicated host created/updated. Returned: When state=present

return_values.name: allocation_time
return_values.description: The time that the Dedicated Host was allocated. Returned: always Sample: "2025-02-12T12:09:22+00:00"

return_values.name: allows_multiple_instance_types
return_values.description: Indicates whether the Dedicated Host supports multiple instance types of the same instance family. Returned: always Sample: "off"

return_values.name: asset_id
return_values.description: The ID of the Outpost hardware asset on which the Dedicated Host is allocated. Returned: always Sample: "abcdefgh"

return_values.name: auto_placement
return_values.description: Whether auto-placement is on or off. Returned: always Sample: "off"

return_values.name: availability_zone
return_values.description: The Availability Zone of the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "us-east-1b"

return_values.name: availability_zone_id
return_values.description: The ID of the Availability Zone in which the Dedicated Host is allocated. Returned: always Sample: "use1-az6"

return_values.name: available_capacity
return_values.description: Information about the instances running on the Dedicated Host. Returned: always

return_values.name: available_instance_capacity
return_values.description: The number of instances that can be launched onto the Dedicated Host. Returned: always

return_values.name: instance_type
return_values.description: The instance type supported by the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "mac2.metal"

return_values.name: total_capacity
return_values.description: The total number of instances that can be launched onto the Dedicated Host if there are no instances running on it. Returned: always Sample: 1

return_values.name: available_v_cpus
return_values.description: The number of vCPUs available for launching instances onto the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: 8

return_values.name: client_token
return_values.description: Unique, case-sensitive identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotency of the request. Returned: always Sample: "token-0123456789a"

return_values.name: host_id
return_values.description: The ID of the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "h-03f51341e6e39f848"

return_values.name: host_maintenance
return_values.description: Indicates whether host maintenance is enabled or disabled for the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "off"

return_values.name: host_properties
return_values.description: The hardware specifications of the Dedicated Host. Returned: always

return_values.name: cores
return_values.description: The number of cores on the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: 8

return_values.name: instance_family
return_values.description: The instance family supported by the Dedicated Host. Returned: if defined Sample: "mac2"

return_values.name: sockets
return_values.description: The number of sockets on the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: 1

return_values.name: total_v_cpus
return_values.description: The total number of vCPUs on the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: 8

return_values.name: host_recovery
return_values.description: Indicates whether host recovery is enabled or disabled for the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "off"

return_values.name: host_reservation_id
return_values.description: The reservation ID of the Dedicated Host. Returned: always

return_values.name: instances
return_values.description: The IDs and instance type that are currently running on the Dedicated Host. Returned: always

return_values.name: instance_id
return_values.description: The ID of instance that is running on the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "i-0123456789abcd"

return_values.name: owner_id
return_values.description: The ID of the Amazon Web Services account that owns the instance. Returned: always Sample: "0123456789"

return_values.name: member_of_service_linked_resource_group
return_values.description: Indicates whether the Dedicated Host is in a host resource group. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: outpost_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon Web Services Outpost on which the Dedicated Host is allocated. Returned: always Sample: "arn:aws:outposts:us-east-1:0123012301230123:outpost/op-0123456789abcdef0"

return_values.name: release_time
return_values.description: The time that the Dedicated Host was released. Returned: always Sample: "2025-02-12T12:09:22+00:00"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The state of the Dedicated Host. Returned: always Sample: "available"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Dictionary of tags added to the dedicated host. Returned: always Sample: {}
